title: Graine2Pain
description:
Premium portfolio for Athéna Moreau, UX/UI designer and co-associate at Selenium Studio. A technically ambitious site built with Awwwards submission in mind: advanced animations, smooth transitions, refined interactions, and polished visual effects. I handled the entire front-end development and advised on design decisions to ensure both creative excellence and technical feasibility.

Roles & technologies: full front-end development • design consulting • Next.js • Three.js • GSAP • Tailwind CSS • Figma

title: Selenium Studio
description:
Premium web agency combining design and development, founded and co-directed alongside two partners. Selenium Studio supports its clients from strategy to launch: custom landing pages, B2B/B2C tools, rebranding, and data automation. I act as creator and co-director, driving the product vision and directly contributing to front-end development (fast, responsive, and accessible interfaces).

Roles & technologies: co-founder & co-director • front-end development • Next.js • React • GSAP • Figma • Technical SEO

title: BikeFleet
description:
Mobile app for motorcycle enthusiasts to manage their garage. BikeFleet lets you track maintenance, store key documents (insurance, invoices, registration), and keep a full history for every bike. Available on App Store and Google Play. As lead front-end developer (React Native), I handled end-to-end development of the iOS/Android app, from Design System integration to core features.

Roles & technologies: React Native development • iOS & Android • state management • Design System • Figma

title: Cécile Lochus
description:
Former web designer's portfolio, crafted to reflect her creative universe while ensuring smooth navigation. I managed the full integration using Next.js and Tailwind CSS, orchestrated GSAP animations, and coordinated the project via Trello before deploying on Vercel.

Roles & technologies: Next.js development • Tailwind CSS • GSAP • Figma • Trello • Vercel

title: Yeu-Milano
description:
Online portfolio for an artist, designed to showcase their work with subtle animations and a modern layout. I implemented the entire site in Next.js, enhanced interactions with GSAP, styled components with Tailwind CSS, and deployed on Vercel.

Roles & technologies: Next.js development • Tailwind CSS • GSAP • Vercel • ShadCN/UI

title: Histofy
description:
Personal project automating Spotify playlist creation: each month, Histofy gathers every track you've liked into a single playlist, so you can relive your musical journey without searching for each song. I designed the UI with an artist, built the integration natively (no framework), and developed the script interacting with the Spotify API, deployed via Docker then Vercel.

Roles & technologies: UX/UI design • HTML/CSS/JS integration • Spotify API • DevOps (Docker, Vercel) • Figma • Trello
